query:
SELECT id, firstName, lastName, email, phone, status, createdAt, organizationId
FROM leads
WHERE LOWER(lastName) LIKE '%gregory%' OR LOWER(firstName) LIKE '%debbie%'
ORDER BY createdAt ASC
LIMIT 10;
